k_db_partition.why: table partitioning, unrelated to queue ordering

k_email_worker.why: email worker pool, not per-account ordering

k_inflight_lock.why: per-account lock prevents out-of-order concurrent processing

k_partition_key.why: hash by account id keeps events ordered per account

k_sequence_number.why: per-account sequence number drops out-of-order events

k_single_consumer_per_partition.why: one consumer per partition preserves sequencing
